text: {"label":"Disseminating and Expanding Behavior Science","definition":"Work on spreading behavior science beyond its usual settings through public communication, plain language, social media, entrepreneurship, technology, artificial intelligence, community psychology and public policy, broadening its reach and impact.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on outreach, accessibility and extending behavior science into new settings and technologies, rather than qualitative methods, theoretical dimensions, or the history and identity of applied behavior analysis."}
